description: Catchfree produces plant-based seafood products, including shrimp, fish burgers, and snacks, made from rice, soy protein, and algae.
funding_summary: In April 2025, Catchfree secured CHF 1.2 million in seed funding, led by the FortyOne Group and the Stiftung Startfeld, with participation from various industry and private investors, as well as business angels.
